query:
SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'active' AND latitude IS NULL AND city IS NOT NULL AND city != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as active_has_city_no_geocode,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'active' AND latitude IS NULL AND (city IS NULL OR city = '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as active_no_city_no_geocode,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'active' AND latitude IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as active_not_geocoded
FROM pco_people;
